rows.label: Chains of Harrow
rows.note: needs a visit to Onkko in Cetus

conditions: The Sacrifice unlocks in the Codex once Apostasy Prologue is done, and it is solo only.

groups.activity: build a 1-1-1 Amp before the Operator fights
conditions: The starter Mote Amp makes the Neptune and Tycho fights slow; players who swapped to a 1-1-1 called them easy. It does not need to be Gilded.
bonuses: Sentient Cores for the parts come from Vomvalysts at night on the Plains, or from tagging along on a Teralyst capture.

groups.activity: the six quest missions, in order

rows.label: Excalibur Umbra Blueprint
rows.note: Lith, Earth: scan the four remains in the courtyard

rows.label: Vitruvian
rows.note: Pavlov, Lua: place it in its Orbiter slot to unlock the build

rows.label: Excalibur Umbra
rows.note: Nuovo, Triton, then Tycho as the Operator; arrives at rank 30 with a Reactor and his own slot

conditions: In the Neptune and Tycho fights, strip his shield with Void Beam, stun him with Void Sling, then Transference into him.
One copy per account: replays never give a second blueprint, no vendor sells one, and he cannot be sold.
bonuses: An inbox message after the quest sends the Sunder Helmet, animation sets and a Captura scene.

disclosures.title: how to win the Operator fights
disclosures.body: Get somewhere high: his pathing cannot reach the roots in the Tycho room, the rafters in the Neptune fight or stacked crates. His shield and health do not reset when you die, and a respawn gives a few free seconds to shoot. Otherwise hit and run: shoot as he closes, then Void Dash away before he reaches melee range.

disclosures.title: when a phase will not advance
disclosures.body: If Void Sling does not stun him, restart the stage; the bug clears on retry. Transferring in too early can leave you inside an invisible Umbra. Do not have a channelled Exalted Weapon active when you Void Sling into him. On mobile touch controls, the black-and-gold path after the final memory can lose its movement buttons; use a gamepad or play that section on PC through cross-save.

disclosures.title: Somachord fragments
disclosures.body: Optional fragments must be scanned in mission order. Missing one stops the later ones spawning, and only a quest replay brings them back.

rows.label: Excalibur Umbra
rows.note: 10,000 cr, 1 Orokin Cell, 60 Kuva, 1,200 Nano Spores, 1,600 Alloy Plate

conditions: The quest cannot continue until he is built and equipped in the Arsenal. The build cannot be rushed or bought.
bonuses: Skiajati arrives during the same quest at rank 30 and counts for Mastery too.
